title: Spontaneous self-assembly of mangiferin in an aqueous medium into vesicles for anticancer drug encapsulation and antibacterial applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,28103-28112
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01279E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sukhendu Kar, Soumen Patra, Wachirasak Thaisaeng, Chatphorn Theppitak, Nopporn Thasana, Braja Gopal Bag
Mangiferin spontaneously self-assembles into stable vesicles in aqueous solutions. These nanocarriers encapsulate anticancer drugs (doxorubicin/curcumin) and display significantly enhanced antibacterial activities when loaded with curcumin.
